Round105F.kernel_uniform_cutoff_cost.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : Measure X)
  [SFinite mu] (B C : X → X → ℂ) (hB : MemLp (fun p => B p.1 p.2) 2 (mu.prod mu))
  (hC : MemLp (fun p => C p.1 p.2) 2 (mu.prod mu)) (S : Set X) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (cutoff : X → ℂ)
  (hmcut : AEStronglyMeasurable cutoff mu) (hbcut : ∀ (x : X), ‖cutoff x‖ ≤ 1) (hcore : ∀ x ∈ S, cutoff x = 1)
  (e : HilbertBasis ι ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  ∃ T u v,
    (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
        ∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂mu, ↑↑(T F) x = (cutoff x - 1) * ∫ (z : X), B x z * ∫ (y : X), C z y * ↑↑F y ∂mu ∂mu) ∧
      (Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖(innerSL ℂ) (v i)‖) ∧
        ∑' (i : ι), ‖u i‖ * ‖(innerSL ℂ) (v i)‖ ≤
            √(4 * ∫ (p : X × X), (Sᶜ ×ˢ Set.univ).indicator (fun p => ‖B p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) p ∂mu.prod mu) *
              √(∫ (p : X × X), ‖C p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂mu.prod mu) ∧
          HasSum (fun i => ((innerSL ℂ) (v i)).smulRight (u i)) T

Round105F.genuine_residual_uniform_cutoff_cost.{u_1, u_2} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] {ι : Type u_2}
  (mu : Measure (NuclearBoundB90.Classes K)) [SFinite mu] (alpha s R S B : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (rho psi theta : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K → ℂ) (second : Bool) (hell : Measurable (Round103E.actualLog K)) (V : ℝ≥0)
  (hpush : Measure.map (Round103E.actualLog K) mu = ↑V • volume) (hrho : ∀ (x : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), ‖rho x‖ ≤ B)
  (hm : Measurable fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (9 * ‖rho x‖ ^ 2 / (1 + Round103E.actualLog K x ^ 2)))
  (hb : Measurable fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (1 + Round103E.actualLog K x ^ 2)))
  (hp : Measurable fun g => ENNReal.ofReal (Round94F.testDensity K (Round103E.actualLog K) alpha s psi true g))
  (ht : Measurable fun g => ENNReal.ofReal (Round94F.testDensity K (Round103E.actualLog K) alpha s theta false g))
  (hp0 : Measurable fun g => ENNReal.ofReal (‖psi g‖ ^ 2)) (ht0 : Measurable fun g => ENNReal.ofReal (‖theta g‖ ^ 2))
  (hpsupp : ∀ (g : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), psi g ≠ 0 → |Round103E.actualLog K g| ≤ R)
  (htsupp : ∀ (g : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), theta g ≠ 0 → |Round103E.actualLog K g| ≤ S)
  (hpf : ∫⁻ (g : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), ENNReal.ofReal (‖psi g‖ ^ 2) ∂mu ≠ ⊤)
  (htf : ∫⁻ (g : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), ENNReal.ofReal (‖theta g‖ ^ 2) ∂mu ≠ ⊤)
  (hpres : ∀ (x : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), MeasurePreserving (fun y => x * y⁻¹) mu mu)
  (hemb : ∀ (x : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), MeasurableEmbedding fun y => x * y⁻¹)
  (hka :
    AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun z => Round96F.residualFactorKernel K (Round103E.actualLog K) alpha s rho psi second z.1 z.2) (mu.prod mu))
  (hkb :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => Round94F.factorKernel K (Round103E.actualLog K) alpha s theta false z.1 z.2)
      (mu.prod mu))
  (Tcore : ℝ) (cutoff : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K → ℂ) (hmcut : AEStronglyMeasurable cutoff mu)
  (hbcut : ∀ (x : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), ‖cutoff x‖ ≤ 1)
  (hcore : ∀ (x : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K), |Round103E.actualLog K x| ≤ Tcore → cutoff x = 1)
  (e : HilbertBasis ι ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  ∃ T u v,
    (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
        ∀ᵐ (x : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K) ∂mu,
          ↑↑(T F) x =
            (cutoff x - 1) *
              ∫ (y : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K),
                rho x * Round98F.signedResidualMultiplier (Round103E.actualLog K x) second *
                    NuclearBoundB91.transportedCutoffKernel K (fun x => 1) (NuclearBoundB90.convolution K mu psi theta)
                      (fun a => Round93A.stripWeight alpha s (Round103E.actualLog K a)) x y *
                  ↑↑F y ∂mu) ∧
      (Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖(innerSL ℂ) (v i)‖) ∧
        ∑' (i : ι), ‖u i‖ * ‖(innerSL ℂ) (v i)‖ ≤
            √(4 *
                  ∫ (p : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K × NuclearBoundB90.Classes K),
                    ({x | |Round103E.actualLog K x| ≤ Tcore}ᶜ ×ˢ Set.univ).indicator
                      (fun p =>
                        ‖Round96F.residualFactorKernel K (Round103E.actualLog K) alpha s rho psi second p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
                      p ∂mu.prod mu) *
              √(∫ (p : NuclearBoundB90.Classes K × NuclearBoundB90.Classes K),
                  ‖Round94F.factorKernel K (Round103E.actualLog K) alpha s theta false p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂mu.prod mu) ∧
          HasSum (fun i => ((innerSL ℂ) (v i)).smulRight (u i)) T
